title: OTEX Texture Pack
description: Created by Ola Bjorling (ukiro), OTEX is a texture resource pack featuring over 2,600 textures and 1,300 flats in the classic Doom style with modern twists. It encompasses a wide range of themes, from tech and concrete to ice and brick, alongside 51 skies, custom switch pairs, and 77 animated textures.

screenshots.caption: A screenshot of MAP21 of Eviternity, which uses OTEX

notes: [Official site](https://doom.ukiro.com/) • Resource pack for mappers, not playable standalone.
